facts.statement: The genus Krzyzanowskisaurus, meaning "Stan Krzyżanowski's lizard", was named after a person and is known from the Late Triassic Chinle Formation.
facts.quote: Krzyzanowskisaurus (meaning "Stan Krzyżanowski's lizard") is the name given to a genus of archosaur from the Late Triassic-aged Chinle Formation

facts.statement: Krzyzanowskisaurus is a tooth taxon known only from fossils of teeth, including the holotype tooth NMMNH P-29357.
facts.quote: it is a tooth taxon, based on fossils only of teeth (such as the holotype tooth NMMNH P-29357)

facts.statement: Fossils of Krzyzanowskisaurus teeth have been found in the U.S. states of Arizona and New Mexico.
facts.quote: these teeth have been found in the U.S. states of Arizona (including the type locality) and New Mexico

facts.statement: The original report described Krzyzanowskisaurus as a probable ornithischian dinosaur.
facts.quote: The original report described it as a "probable ornithischian"

facts.statement: The name was changed from Revueltosaurus hunti to Krzyzanowskisaurus hunti because the type species of Revueltosaurus was found to be a pseudosuchian rather than an ornithischian dinosaur.
facts.quote: The name was changed when it was discovered that the type species of Revueltosaurus, R. callenderi, was a pseudosuchian rather than an ornithischian dinosaur

facts.statement: Irmis et al. (2006) challenged the classification of Krzyzanowskisaurus as a new genus, noting that its cingulum differed from true early ornithischians and that associated skull bones and osteoderms matched Revueltosaurus.
facts.quote: This was challenged by Irmis et al. (2006), who found that the cingulum differed from that in true early ornithischians, and noted that some teeth had been found with skull bones and osteoderms that matched those of Revueltosaurus

facts.statement: Krzyzanowskisaurus lived from the Carnian to the Norian stages, approximately 237 to 205.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Norian (237 to 205.7 million years ago)

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Krzyzanowskisaurus as Ornithischia.
Krzyzanowskisaurus is classified within the unranked order Archosauria.
Krzyzanowskisaurus is tentatively classified within the unranked family Crurotarsi.
